::: {.book-project}
## Learn by Designing a Real AI System

Choose a domain and develop an AI-powered research assistant through a sustained design-and-evaluate project. Build a portfolio of reasoned decisions; a working prototype is optional.

- **Define the purpose:** a project charter, model-selection memo, and prompt library.
- **Design the system:** an integration architecture, agent capability plan, RAG design, and customization decision.
- **Ground and test decisions:** a literature review and proposal, multimodal extension plan, evaluation plan, and optimization plan.
- **Plan responsible use:** a red-team review, ethics and fairness review, compliance checklist, and deployment plan with a forward look.

Each milestone adds to the same project, so earlier choices can be tested and revised as your understanding grows. [Explore the learning approach in the Preface](preface.qmd#learning-by-designing).
:::

::: {.book-reader-grid}
::: {.book-audience}
## Who This Book Is For

Advanced undergraduate and graduate students, instructors, software engineers, data scientists, researchers, AI practitioners, and technical professionals who want to connect generative AI concepts with system design and responsible practice.
:::
::: {.book-learning}
## How You Will Learn

Start with concepts, then examine real examples, technical examples, and case studies. Use discussion questions to test your reasoning and project milestones to document it. Evaluation and responsible deployment connect the technical decisions throughout the book.
:::
:::
